text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I came up with so many proverbs today,
I've gotta write them in my Chiyo-Notebook before I forget...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: My Chiyo-notebook is filling up nicely. Maybe I should compile the proverbs separately.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, this brings back memories.
"Taking shortcuts is against the rules."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Three minutes on the turf," "Serve meals with haste."
Man, there were sayings like that too, huh.
Feels like the early maxims had a lot of raw energy behind them.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"'Get more hard rice crackers.'
Maybe this maxim could be improved."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"If I remake it with the knowledge I have now...
...'Pound the rice cracker before you eat it'!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: This work might actually be tougher than I thought...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Still, the quality improved so much, so I think I'll go fix the other maxims too!"

Sakura Chiyono O completely lost track of time
working on it, and ended up skipping her training.
